current_behaviour: Six suggestion registers and five question registers across four id schemes, published on six pages, with no index.
improvement: One decision hub that maps all 166 rows onto 16 canonical decisions and links back to every original.
why_it_improves_decision_making: A reviewer can see the whole decision surface at once and can prove nothing was dropped, instead of guessing which page is current.
options: A) Hub only, keep every original page. B) Hub plus retire the duplicates. C) Leave as is.
risk: Low — a new page; nothing existing is edited or deleted.

current_behaviour: The scheduled capture stores a time, but the page does not show how stale that capture is or whether the report has moved since.
improvement: Print the capture time on every availability table and publish the cell-level drift between the last two reads of the same official page.
why_it_improves_decision_making: An Out designation that appeared after the capture is invisible otherwise; the drift table makes the rate of change measurable.
options: A) Print capture time + drift table. B) Print capture time only. C) Nothing.
risk: Low — computed from files already committed.

current_behaviour: Injury rows and depth-chart rows are published side by side but never joined, so no page says which string a ruled-out player is or who is next.
improvement: Join every designation to the club's own 1st / 2nd / 3rd / 4th string order and flag compounded deficiencies where the next man is also Out or Doubtful.
why_it_improves_decision_making: This is the requirement the project was missing: it turns an injury list into a lineup-deficiency statement for both offence and defence.
options: A) Join on the committed capture, recompute every run. B) One-off table. C) Nothing.
risk: Low — no network, joins committed files.

current_behaviour: The forward ledger freezes picks before kickoff but nothing grades them once a game settles; all 65 Week 10 picks sat OPEN.
improvement: Grade every frozen pick against the official final as soon as the game is Final, and publish the running record.
why_it_improves_decision_making: It is the only mechanism in the repository that removes hindsight; without grading it produces no evidence at all.
options: A) Grade on demand from a verified official final. B) Schedule a weekly grading job. C) Leave open.
risk: Low for A; B needs a scheduled runner.
status: Partly implemented this session — 1 of 14 games graded; the weekly job is proposed as IMP-12

current_behaviour: A clean `make build` is not byte-identical: `fetch_injuries.py` rewrites the injury manifest with `"sha256": null`, so the file changes on every run.
improvement: Repair the rewrite and add a byte-identity check to CI so a non-deterministic build fails the pipeline.
why_it_improves_decision_making: The claim "a clean build reproduces the published numbers" is one of the project's central evidence claims; drift quietly falsifies it.
options: A) Repair and add a CI check. B) Repair only. C) Leave.
status: Repair carried out this session; the CI byte-identity check is proposed

current_behaviour: Green Bay's 57 depth-chart rows are stored with jersey numbers prefixed, so any join that does not strip them silently matches nothing.
improvement: Strip the number at parse time in `pipeline/fetch_availability.py` as well as in the join.
why_it_improves_decision_making: Today the join compensates, but every other consumer of that file still fails to match an entire club without any error.
options: A) Fix the parser. B) Keep compensating in the join. C) Nothing.
risk: Low, but the file is owned by another session — logged as a cross-scope request, not edited.

current_behaviour: Houston publishes its depth chart as an image, so 0 rows parse and all 16 Houston report rows are unmatched.
improvement: Transcribe the image by hand with a hash and a date, or drop Houston from coverage and say so on the page.
why_it_improves_decision_making: A club silently missing from the register is worse than one visibly excluded.
options: A) Hand-transcribe weekly with a hash. B) Flag and exclude. C) Nothing.
risk: Medium — hand transcription is an inference risk; it must be dated and hash-recorded.

current_behaviour: Four pages answer "what should we do next" (suggestions, decision board, suggestions review, decisions) and the sidebar does not say which is which.
improvement: Group them under one Decide heading with the hub first, and label each as an original register.
why_it_improves_decision_making: Reduces the chance that a reviewer reads one register and believes it is complete.
options: A) Group and label. B) Group, label and reorder. C) Nothing.

current_behaviour: The summary states the decision but not the conditions that would change it.
improvement: Add a "what would change this decision" block naming the two or three measurements that would flip it.
why_it_improves_decision_making: A decision without an overturn condition cannot be revisited on evidence.
options: A) Add the block. B) Leave.

current_behaviour: The state of gates, suggestions and questions is spread across HTML and CSVs with no single file.
improvement: Publish a `decisions.json` with the state of every gate and every canonical decision, so two builds can be diffed.
why_it_improves_decision_making: Makes drift between builds visible without reading pages.
options: A) Publish the file. B) Leave.

current_behaviour: Pages say what they were built from but not when each was last verified.
improvement: Print a per-page "last verified" line naming the exact command and timestamp.
why_it_improves_decision_making: A reader cannot otherwise tell whether a table was checked this week or last month.
options: A) Add the line. B) Leave.
risk: Low — rendered from a build timestamp.

current_behaviour: Grading the forward ledger is manual: it needs someone to read the official final and run the grade.
improvement: A scheduled workflow that reads official finals for settled games and grades the frozen picks, then commits the result.
why_it_improves_decision_making: Turns a one-off demonstration into a cumulative prospective record without manual input.
options: A) Weekly scheduled grading job. B) Grade at end of season. C) Manual.
risk: Low, but it must never grade against an unofficial score.

current_behaviour: No alert exists when a first-listed quarterback, offensive lineman or defensive back is ruled Out or Doubtful.
improvement: Add a rule that raises a flag row whenever such a designation appears, with the string and next man attached.
why_it_improves_decision_making: These are the positions where the join shows the largest cascades; a flag makes them impossible to miss.
options: A) Flag on the page. B) Flag plus a workflow annotation. C) Nothing.

current_behaviour: One leaderboard, with every numeric cell blank under the strict rule, so nothing can be compared.
improvement: Publish two boards: an eligibility board (which strategy has passed which gate) and a labelled risk-adjusted research board.
why_it_improves_decision_making: Separates "may be rewarded" from "ranked by our own estimate", which is the distinction the strict rule exists to protect.
options: A) Two boards. B) One board with a toggle. C) Nothing.
risk: Medium — depends on the DH-01 evidence-display decision.

current_behaviour: Three generations of pages ship together: the root dashboard, the `lab/` annex and `archive/` copies of earlier builds.
improvement: Label every archived page as superseded with a date and a link to its successor, or remove them from the served site.
why_it_improves_decision_making: A search result can otherwise land a reviewer on a superseded build without warning.
options: A) Label in place. B) Remove from the served site. C) Nothing.
risk: Low for A; B loses audit history.
